svg.text: FIS Chaos F — Step Functions Saga + Lambda + DynamoDB
Order workflow with Retry/Catch and compensating transactions; FIS has no Step Functions action, so faults go into the forward-path Lambdas
Step Functions Standard workflow 'order-saga' (logs ALL, X-Ray)
AWS FIS experiments (FisStack) — target the forward-path Lambdas, not Step Functions
F-1 ProcessPayment outage -> retry exhaustion, then ReleaseInventory compensation
F-2 ReserveInventory outage -> fail-fast: Saga fails at the first step, no compensation runs
F-3 ConfirmOrder outage -> two-stage compensation in order: RefundPayment, then ReleaseInventory
All: aws:lambda:invocation-error · preventExecution=true · 100% · 5 min (FIS Lambda extension layer). There is no aws:states:* FIS action.
